Boiler fault codes

Draft. A list of the fault codes we see most often on Worcester and Vaillant boilers, what each one usually means, and whether you can reset it yourself. EA on a Worcester is usually low pressure; F22 on a Vaillant is the same thing. Top the pressure up to 1.5 bar using the filling loop and reset. If it drops again within a week there is a leak somewhere and you should call us.
